projects.name: Bagdad expansion
projects.quote: In late 2023, FCX completed technical and economic studies, which indicate the opportunity to construct new concentrating facilities to increase copper production by 200 to 250 million pounds per year at estimated incremental project capital costs of approximately $3.5 billion.

projects.name: PT-FI new gas-fired combined cycle facility
projects.quote: The majority of PT- FI’s planned investments in a new gas-fired combined cycle facility are expected to be incurred over the next three years, at a cost of approximately $1 billion, which represents an incremental cost of $0.4 billion compared to previously planned investments to refurbish the existing coal units.

projects.name: PT-FI new smelter
projects.quote: Construction of the new greenfield smelter in Eastern Java, Indonesia was substantially completed during 2024.
